notes: HamsterToken is a plain fixed-supply OpenZeppelin ERC-20 named HAMSTER (symbol HAMSTER, 18 decimals). Its constructor takes no arguments and mints 1,000,000,000 HAMSTER (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units) exactly once to msg.sender, the factory. There is no owner, no further minting, no burn hook, no tax, no pause, no blacklist and no upgrade path; ordinary transfers and allowances are the only behaviour. HamsterRewards is the launch's one application contract, for the Hamster Hour game at hamster-hour-bet-on-the-wheel.sites.imd.fun (bet, lose, win HAMSTER). Its constructor takes the token address ($token) and its Ownable2Step owner ($requester, the economics remainder recipient). It holds no HAMSTER at launch and is allocated none by the factory; it only pays out HAMSTER that donors later deposit through fund(amount), one HAMSTER base unit per IMD base unit of eligible losing stake, to bettors whose losses the existing game records as settled. The owner's only power is a one-time configureGame(game, firstWindow) that selects the already deployed game contract (verified to report IMD at 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7) and a future first eligible window; after that the owner has no reward, withdrawal or balance controls, and renounceOwnership is only allowed once configured. Claims are per wallet per window, never mint, and revert rather than pay partially when inventory is short. No initialization calls are needed at launch. The pool pairs HAMSTER with IMD at the launch policy's 1.25% fee and tick spacing 60; the deployer derives the opening price from the 888 IMD market cap in economics, so initialPrice is provenance only.
